title: Great guide
text: Philip was a great guide. Extremely knowledgable and passinate with his explanations. My son especially loved it as it was different from the usual museums, etc.
author: Explore710753

title: Brilliant time!!
text:
We had such a fantastic time on our Segway tour with Philip! We had a brilliant time from start to finish. Philip was funny, friendly and really knowledgeable, making the whole experience enjoyable and relaxed.

Going up into the mountain was definitely a highlight — the views were absolutely wonderful and it was such a great way to see a different side of Barcelona.

We’d definitely recommend this tour, and especially Philip as a guide. Thanks for a brilliant experience! 😊
author: FlickHams

title: Worth your money - great way to see Barcelona
text: We had an amazing time on the Segway tour. Alex was a great guide who took his time, explained the history with passion and also took us to some great spots. He also ensured we got comfortable on the Segway and was ensuring we felt completely safe during the entire tour. Highly recommend Euro Segway and Alex.
author: Vijay_V

title: Must do in Barcelona!
text: Though rainy, the Segway was armed with raincoats and thus we could still go about visiting the spots! Would be much better on a sunny day!
author: Joanne_L

title: Fun tour with Alex
text: Thank you to Alex for a fun and informative tour of Barcelona with my wife and son. Segways and e-scooters were available- we opted for the latter and they worked really well. Alex was great, fitting us in even though we arrived a day early for our booking!!
author: G6786XLdavidk

title: Good Starter Tour
text:
Honestly, I highly recommend this tour and a good starter tour for your nights you will stay at Barcelona. 

Pablo was a good guide, & showed the city and gave excellent suggestions for things to do around the city. 

Please, do visit this place & you would not regret it.
author: Kevin_K

title: family fun time
text: Learning how to ride the Segway was easy, the tour guide was very experienced. the route was also fun and we took great pictures. We all loved it
author: olatundem2025

title: A commendable Segway Tour of Barcelona
text:
A wonderful guided tour. The introduction with the Segway was important and right. 
The guided tour was very impressive and impressive and above all safe. 
Our guide took very good care of us. We would recommend this tour to anyone who fancy a varied ride to the hotspots of the city. We were about 13 km in the city in the about 2 hours 🌍
